{{Top|leg}}
'''Security and Law Enforcement''' was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] division of [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|Outer Rim Oreworks]].

[[Hugo Bartyn]] seized the budget of Security and Law Enforcement for the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] and manipulated it so that ORO would pay the salary of the [[Security Chief (ORO)|Security Chief]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]], his own fishing city which was not affiliated to ORO.
